questions.question: For drivers 21 and older, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:
questions.explanation: Drivers age 21 and older cannot legally drive with a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher. Driving under the influence of alcohol is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: ____ reduce your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only a BAC above the legal limit can
Even a small amount of alcohol can
Only a BAC above 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even a small amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol reduces your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory. It hurts your driving skills. No one can drink and drive safely.

questions.question: When you see or hear an emergency vehicle coming, you should:

options.text: Stop immediately and let the vehicle pass.
Move to the right side of the road as safely as you can and stop.
Drive slowly and let the vehicle pass.
Keep moving slowly on the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right side of the road as safely as you can and stop.
questions.explanation: On any road, you must yield to an emergency vehicle using lights and/or sirens. Move as far to the right as safely possible and stop. Do not stop in an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When driving near heavy trucks, you must account for:

options.text: The longer distance large vehicles need to stop.
The shorter distance large vehicles need to stop.
The less noise large vehicles make.
The faster speed of large vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: The longer distance large vehicles need to stop.
questions.explanation: Large trucks need more distance to stop. Stay where the truck driver can see you. Do not position your vehicle where the truck blocks your view of traffic.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the centerline means:
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, which has the right-of-way?

options.text: The vehicle approaching from the right.
The vehicle approaching from the left.
The vehicle whose driver honks first.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle approaching from the right.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no traffic control device, yield to the vehicle coming from your right.

questions.question: If you miss your exit on the interstate, you should:

options.text: Quickly cut across traffic to make your turn.
Make a U-turn to go back to your exit.
Put your vehicle in reverse to go back.

questions.explanation: Do not make a sudden turn to catch your exit. Continue driving to the next exit instead.

questions.question: When crossing railroad tracks without signals or gates, you should:

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You may pass slower drivers while crossing.
Make sure your vehicle can cross completely without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your vehicle can cross completely without stopping.
questions.explanation: Before driving onto railroad tracks, check that you have enough space to clear the tracks without stopping. Never pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing. Always look for trains before crossing tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has multiple turns and curves.

questions.question: What causes many crashes?

options.text: Drivers going too fast for the conditions.
Drivers checking their mirrors and blind spots.
Drivers giving the right-of-way to others.
Drivers keeping a four-second distance behind other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers going too fast for the conditions.
questions.explanation: Many crashes happen when drivers go too fast for road conditions. Always drive at or below the speed limit. Slow down when conditions are not perfect.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They get you ready for road hazards ahead. This sign warns of low clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: When is street racing allowed?
questions.explanation: Street racing is illegal and dangerous. It causes serious injuries and deaths. Racers use public roads and go too fast to react to hazards or other drivers. This results in crashes.

questions.question: What color are highway exit distance signs?
questions.explanation: Green signs with white letters show directions and destination information.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at the same speed.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic light is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: Larger vehicles have:

options.text: The same blind spots as smaller vehicles.

questions.explanation: Larger vehicles have bigger blind spots. Large trucks and SUVs have areas near the back that you cannot see in the side or rearview mirrors.

questions.question: To reduce headlight glare at night, you should look:

options.text: At the center of the road.
To the right edge of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: To the right edge of the road.
questions.explanation: If oncoming headlights are bright, keep your eyes on the right side of the road. Do not look directly at bright headlights because the glare can temporarily blind you.

questions.question: Keeping space between your vehicle and others is important because it:

options.text: Allows you time to react to unexpected situations.
Keeps traffic flowing at a safe pace.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allows you time to react to unexpected situations.
questions.explanation: Extra space between your vehicle and others gives you time to react if other drivers make mistakes.

questions.question: When driving on icy or snowy roads, which technique helps avoid crashes?

options.text: Add extra weight to your vehicle for better traction.
Get off the highways as quickly as possible.
Slow down and increase your following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and increase your following distance.
questions.explanation: On snowy or icy roads, slow down and increase the distance between your vehicle and others. These are the most important ways to avoid crashes.

questions.question: When driving in traffic, it is safest to:

options.text: Change your speed to stay alert.
Drive with the flow of traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go faster or slower than other vehicles. Always drive with the flow of traffic, staying within the speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction or maintenance work is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Construction or maintenance work is ahead.
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns drivers about construction or maintenance zones ahead. Slow down and drive carefully when you see it.

questions.question: Your vehicle hits a parked car and the owner is not there. You must:

options.text: Have done as much as you can.
Leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.
Leave and go on your way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.
questions.explanation: If you hit a parked car and cannot find the owner, you must leave a written note with your name, address, and details about the accident.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming, so prepare to stop completely before going.

questions.question: You cannot pass other vehicles within ____ of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel.
questions.explanation: Do not pass other vehicles within 100 feet of a bridge, viaduct, tunnel, railroad crossing, or intersection. Only pass where it is legal and safe.
